reviews.title: MindMax Away…
reviews.text: I’m really enjoying this app. It’s very animated very personal understands me and explains everything in great details. It’s way worth the money.

reviews.title: LOVING this app!!!
reviews.text: I am still completing my real estate coursework online. But I have been struggling to retain the info. I read it, but there is so much of it coning at me that it just bounces off my brain. This app takes a different approach and breaks out the big crayons to help you learn better and faster. I retain and remember more with MindMax than I remember with my online course.

reviews.title: Slow learner
reviews.text: I have been studying for a couple of weeks and nothing would click. I seen the ad in on IG and I have been using the free version and just that alone has helped me so much. I’m no longer fearing the Exam but becoming more confident with my knowledge.

reviews.title: Questions?
reviews.text: I really like MindMax as a unique and clever learning tool. The only thing is: I have questions about ultra versus pro upgrade that for some reason Support has never gotten back to me on. I’ve tried numerous times by email, even called them twice and left messages but they don’t answer. At this point, I’m wondering if they don’t care or simply don’t know basic questions about their own app. Love a reply, guys.

reviews.title: Real Estate exam prep
reviews.text: I had finished my pre-licensing classes, passed my class exam and now had to get ready for state licensing. It was a daunting task to even know where to begin. I saw an ad for MindMax and figured I would give it a shot. I was blown away at how detailed and spot on this was for my state specific exam material. It explained & illustrated the math concepts even more clearly than my instructor had. Happy to say I passed my licensing exam and wish I had found this app way sooner.

reviews.title: Great app, but does have some bugs to fix
reviews.text: I’m enjoying this app immensely. However, the app does sometimes lag when moving through the lessons. I’ve had to force quit the app several times to reload, since it “sticks”, and doesn’t move to the next segment. Otherwise, I love it.

reviews.title: Bug in quizzes
reviews.text: There’s a bug in the quizzes causing the screen to rapidly and constantly flicker. It’s happening on different quizzes and different questions but not all.

reviews.title: Amateur Radio
reviews.text: Best learning tool I’ve ever seen. I love it.

reviews.title: Good not great
reviews.text:
Good: 
Several side-kicks 

A ton of Tutors (some historical and some fictional, tho the descriptions are pretty bad, you’ll have to google any you don’t know).

The free trial is a week long with 60m a day

The bad: 
No way to relisten or read transcripts

Customer Service doesn’t respond… 

The tutor changes when you hit a new level, and you don’t get to pick. 

You can’t change your tutor at any point. 

A new level loses all memory of previous level(s). 

After reaching out to customer service multiple times and not receiving a response my review went from 4 stars to 1… at this price I expected decent customer service.

I will be deleting the app until this is fixed and will try to find an alternative. Very unfortunate. This app is a perfect example of, “If it ain’t broke, don’t fix it.”

reviews.title: Pretty Incredible
reviews.text: With all these micro learning applications out there, it’s hard to differentiate one from the other. Not with this app. MindMax is unique. The option to create your own content is pretty incredible and conversing with the Teacher throughout the lesson is an amazing touch. You can ask questions and based on the questions, the content changes in real time to provide you with a solution. Right now I have been testing the Free version and it is great.
